header.purpose: Condition E registry: gen1r shard1 games registered as K0-annotation-consumed before the Stage B formal split is cut
header.ruling: K0 round-2 ruling condition E (reports/K0_ROUND2_RULING_20261114.md, commit 907c1059); design ruling 4438b4ab/f08b266f, supplements 714f2699/0dac1a76
header.rule: these game ids may only fall on the train side or be excluded; they must never enter the test partition of the Stage B formal split

supersedes.note: v1 is kept byte-identical for history. Per r4 item X10 it must not be cited as evidence again; cite this v2 instead.

header.defect_fixed: r4 X10: v1 replay_id degenerate (200/200 'selfplay' -- the generator's constant document id, not a per-game identifier) and no per-entry content hash.
header.replay_id_definition: replay_id is the replay file stem 'selfplay-<game>'. The replay document's own id field is the constant 'selfplay' (kept verbatim in id_field_in_replay); the per-game discriminator inside the document is result.open_seed, read back from every replay file at build time and equal to game and to the index open_seed.
header.content_hash_definition: sha256/md5/bytes are computed over the stored .json.gz file bytes at build time; sha256 is asserted equal to the shard index's recorded sha256 for all 200 entries.
header.built_by: DGX line (X10 owner per strategy-group r4 disposition, forwarded by the war room 2026-11-14)
